answer.reason: The supplied citation is a URL only, with no data excerpt to quote, so I relied on prior knowledge of the World Bank WDI series SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS. Guinea has a young population, but its share of population aged 65+ has risen to roughly 3.4% by 2023; this matches option A (≈3.44%), while option B (≈2.98%) corresponds to an earlier-period level for this indicator, not the 2023 value.
